UnitStatement: Import statements (vitest, harness client) - test scaffolding boilerplate.
HarnessApiClientError is a typed harness client error carrying HTTP status, an error code, message, and optional structured detail payload.
toHarnessUiError(error) maps a harness error into a UI-facing error object with title, code, message, and nextStep fields.
toHarnessUiError maps code WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE to title 'Working Root Unavailable' with a nextStep instructing the user to re-select.
toHarnessUiError maps code TURN_IN_PROGRESS to title 'Turn Already In Progress' with nextStep guidance to wait for the current turn.
toHarnessUiError maps code MISSING_API_KEY to title 'API Key Not Configured' with nextStep referencing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
toHarnessUiError maps ATTACHMENT_FAILURE to title 'Attachment Validation Failed' and includes a 'Rejections:' preview of attachment errors.
toHarnessUiError truncates the attachment rejection preview, appending '(+N more)' when more rejected attachments exist than are shown.
toHarnessUiError falls back to base attachment copy when attachment rejection details are malformed.
toHarnessUiError falls back to generic title 'Harness Request Failed' and surfaces the raw code for unknown error codes.
toHarnessUiError maps INSTRUCTION_ROOT_INVALID to title 'Instruction Root Invalid' with a nextStep instructing reinstall.
toHarnessUiError returns 'Unexpected Harness Failure' copy for non-client (generic Error) inputs, preserving the original message.
instruction-root module exports assertInstructionRootReadable, instructionRootContainsPath, and resolveInstructionRootPath.
A valid instruction root requires docs files DIRECTIVE.md, CONTRACT.md, SPEC.md, TYPES.md, and PLAN.md plus AGENTS.md and README.md.
The instruction root is configured via the CHIRALITY_INSTRUCTION_ROOT environment variable.
resolveInstructionRootPath() returns the absolute (resolved) path of the configured instruction root.
assertInstructionRootReadable() resolves to the absolute instruction-root path when all required resources are present.
assertInstructionRootReadable() rejects with type INSTRUCTION_ROOT_INVALID and details listing missingEntries when a required resource is absent.
instructionRootContainsPath(candidate, root) returns true when candidate equals or is nested under root, and false for siblings outside root.
resolveRuntimeOptions(session, opts) resolves harness runtime options merging persona defaults, global settings, and explicit opts.
resolveRuntimeOptions default model is 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514' when no global or env model is configured.
resolveRuntimeOptions applies persona-declared tools and max_turns defaults, returning persona and mode in the resolved options.
resolveRuntimeOptions resolves model from the instruction-root global (AGENTS.md) setting when configured.
resolveRuntimeOptions does NOT use the persona-level model as a tier-2 fallback when the global model is absent.
Explicit opts (model, tools, maxTurns, mode) override persona and global defaults in resolveRuntimeOptions.
resolveRuntimeOptions honors the CHIRALITY_GLOBAL_MODEL environment variable as a global model override.
resolveRuntimeOptions uses opts.persona override to select which persona defaults (tools, maxTurns) are applied.
resolveRuntimeOptions keeps an explicitly provided empty tools array without falling back to persona defaults.
resolveRuntimeOptions passes opts.subagentGovernance through unchanged without fallback remapping.
resolveRuntimeOptions warns and ignores unknown opts fields, logging '[harness/options] Ignoring unknown opts field(s): ...' sorted alphabetically.
resolveRuntimeOptions resolves deterministically: repeated runs with identical inputs produce equal results.
resolveRuntimeOptions falls back to runtime default tools ['read','write','bash'] and maxTurns 12 when persona frontmatter is malformed (missing closing delimiter), emitting a warning.
resolveRuntimeOptions rejects with type PERSONA_NOT_FOUND when the persona instruction file is missing.
harness runtime module exports getHarnessRuntime, resetHarnessRuntimeForTests, and resolveHarnessProviderMode.
The harness provider mode is selected via the CHIRALITY_HARNESS_PROVIDER environment variable.
resolveHarnessProviderMode() defaults to 'stub' when the provider env is unset; the runtime then uses StubAgentSdkManager and a TurnEngine.
Setting CHIRALITY_HARNESS_PROVIDER='anthropic' selects anthropic mode and uses AnthropicAgentSdkManager.
Setting CHIRALITY_HARNESS_PROVIDER='agentSdk' selects Claude Agent SDK mode and uses ClaudeAgentSdkManager.
sanitizeLabel(label) sanitizes a label string for filesystem-safe use.
sanitizeLabel keeps already-clean labels unchanged.
sanitizeLabel replaces illegal filesystem characters (: / < > |) with a hyphen.
sanitizeLabel collapses internal whitespace runs to a single space and trims leading/trailing whitespace.
scaffold module exports previewScaffoldExecutionRoot and scaffoldExecutionRoot.
previewScaffoldExecutionRoot parses a decomposition markdown and returns projectName, packageCount, deliverableCount, and planned directories/files without writing to disk.
The scaffold plan includes an INIT.md file and per-package 1_Working directories under the execution root.
scaffoldExecutionRoot creates execution-root layout, package folders, and deliverable folders, returning layoutValidation.valid=true and preparationCompatibility.ready=true.
scaffoldExecutionRoot creates _Aggregation/_Templates, copies the decomposition into _Decomposition, and writes _Coordination/_COORDINATION.md.
scaffoldExecutionRoot sanitizes package/deliverable names into folder names (e.g. PKG-02 "UI : Shell" becomes "PKG-02_UI - Shell").
_COORDINATION.md records the coordination mode as '**Representation:** HYBRID'.
scaffoldExecutionRoot is idempotent: rerun creates zero new files/directories and does not overwrite existing files.
scaffoldExecutionRoot rejects malformed decomposition input lacking deliverable rows with error type INVALID_REQUEST.
On rerun, scaffoldExecutionRoot reports preparationCompatibility issues (ready=false, issueCount>0) when a metadata file target (e.g. _STATUS.md) is invalid.
scaffoldExecutionRoot fails fast with WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE (status 409) and FAIL_FAST retry diagnostics when a filesystem path conflicts.
subagent-governance module exports evaluateSubagentGovernance(persona, governance, env).
Subagent delegation is gated by the CHIRALITY_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS environment variable.
evaluateSubagentGovernance denies (gate=ENVIRONMENT) when CHIRALITY_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS is not 'true'.
evaluateSubagentGovernance denies (gate=PERSONA_ALLOWLIST) when the persona does not declare allowlisted subagents.
evaluateSubagentGovernance denies (gate=METADATA_PRESENCE) when governance metadata is missing or invalid.
evaluateSubagentGovernance denies with gate=CONTEXT_SEALED or gate=PIPELINE_RUN_APPROVED when those governance booleans are not strictly true.
evaluateSubagentGovernance denies (gate=APPROVAL_REF) when approvalRef is empty or whitespace-only.
evaluateSubagentGovernance allows (gate=ALLOW) and resolves only AGENT_TYPE 2 delegated subagents, rejecting TYPE 1 candidates with an error log.
evaluateSubagentGovernance warns but still allows TYPE 2 subagents whose AGENT_CLASS is not TASK (TASK class is preferred).
evaluateSubagentGovernance records evaluationMs and emits a SLOW_EVALUATION warning when the duration exceeds CHIRALITY_SUBAGENT_GOVERNANCE_WARN_MS.
evaluateSubagentGovernance fails closed (gate=INTERNAL_ERROR) on instruction-root errors, logging an INTERNAL_ERROR diagnostic.
toolkit module exports buildHarnessOptsFromToolkit, defaultToolkitState, sanitizeToolkitState, and upsertToolkitPreset.
buildHarnessOptsFromToolkit returns undefined when all toolkit values are empty.
buildHarnessOptsFromToolkit parses comma/newline-separated tool strings into a tools array and coerces maxTurns to a number.
buildHarnessOptsFromToolkit includes subagentGovernance only when includeSubagentGovernance is explicitly enabled.
sanitizeToolkitState trims values, normalizes presets, and clears a dangling selectedPresetId that no longer references an existing preset.
upsertToolkitPreset places the newest preset at the front of the preset list.
ui-attachments module exports attachmentExtension, attachmentFileName, buildUiAttachment, isSupportedAttachmentPath, and sanitizeStoredAttachments.
attachmentFileName(path) returns the basename and attachmentExtension(path) returns the extension (empty string when none).
isSupportedAttachmentPath(path) returns true for supported extensions (e.g. .png, .jpeg) and false for unsupported ones (e.g. .bin).
buildUiAttachment(path) classifies preview metadata (displayName, mimeType, clientType) from the path extension, defaulting unknown types to application/octet-stream and clientType "unknown".
sanitizeStoredAttachments dedups by path (keeping the latest), backfills missing displayName/mimeType/clientType, and drops malformed rows lacking a path.
shell layout-state module exports COLLAPSED_PANE_WIDTH_PX, LAYOUT_STORAGE_KEY, clampPaneWidthForLayout, createDefaultLayoutState, readLayoutStateFromStorage, and resolvePaneWidth.
readLayoutStateFromStorage returns createDefaultLayoutState() when storage is unavailable or empty.
readLayoutStateFromStorage reads from LAYOUT_STORAGE_KEY and sanitizes persisted payloads, replacing invalid widths/collapsed values with defaults.
Default pane widths are fileTree 220, toolkit 480 (clamped), and chat 320.
resolvePaneWidth returns COLLAPSED_PANE_WIDTH_PX for collapsed panes, 0 for a hidden toolkit, and the stored width otherwise.
clampPaneWidthForLayout clamps requested pane widths against layout constraints (min/max relative to total layout width and toolkit visibility).
clampPaneWidthForLayout falls back to simple min/max clamping when layoutWidth is invalid (e.g. 0).
lifecycle module exports parseStatusDocument, StatusParseError, updateStatusDocument, applyLifecycleTransition, transitionStatusFile, and LifecycleTransitionError.
_STATUS documents record a Current State, Last Updated date, and a History section in list or table format.
parseStatusDocument parses canonical list-format history entries into {date, state, actor, source:"list"} records and reads currentState/lastUpdated.
parseStatusDocument parses table-format history entries (source:"table") for backward compatibility.
updateStatusDocument appends a new transition, preserves prior history, sets the new currentState, and embeds metadata such as **Approval SHA:**.
parseStatusDocument throws StatusParseError for invalid state values.
applyLifecycleTransition allows authorized forward transitions, returning from/to and updated content with the new Current State.
applyLifecycleTransition throws LifecycleTransitionError code UNAUTHORIZED_ACTOR when the actor is not permitted for the transition.
applyLifecycleTransition throws code BACKWARD_TRANSITION for reverse state transitions.
applyLifecycleTransition throws code TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED for non-existent transitions.
applyLifecycleTransition throws code APPROVAL_SHA_REQUIRED when a human-gated transition lacks an approvalSha.
applyLifecycleTransition throws code INVALID_APPROVAL_SHA when the approvalSha format is invalid for a human-gated transition.
applyLifecycleTransition records approval evidence metadata: **Checking Approval SHA:** for CHECKING and **Approval SHA:** for ISSUED transitions.
transitionStatusFile reads a _STATUS.md, applies the transition, and writes the updated content back to disk.
navigation-intent module exports createNavigationIntentScheduler({ onNavigate }).
The navigation scheduler coalesces multiple same-turn schedule() calls into a single navigation to the latest target, deferred to a microtask.
The scheduler navigates once per turn when schedule() calls are separated across microtask turns.
scheduler.cancel() drops a pending navigation while still allowing future scheduling.
permission-overlay module exports createHarnessCanUseTool, HARNESS_PERMISSION_POLICY_VERSION, permissionDecisionToSdkResult, and resolveHarnessPermissionDecision.
resolveHarnessPermissionDecision evaluates a tool/mode/descriptor (with optional explicitDeny) into a permission decision and safeMetadata.
In readOnly mode, read-class tools are allowed with source 'chirality-policy' and safeMetadata allowClass 'read'.

In ask mode, governed write surfaces yield decision 'ask' (requiresHumanApproval); permissionDecisionToSdkResult converts an 'ask' to SDK behavior 'deny' with a 'requires application approval' message.
In workspaceWrite mode, governed write surfaces are allowed (allowClass 'workspace-write', requiresHookApproval) and map to SDK behavior 'allow'.
Governed Bash (descriptor 'shell') is allowed only in workspaceWrite mode after shell hook policy.
Bash yields decision 'ask' in ask mode and decision 'deny' in readOnly mode.
Explicit hard denies override abstract allow and ask decisions, producing decision 'deny' with safeMetadata.hardDeny=true.
In dontAsk mode, Write/Bash/WebFetch/Agent/unknown tools are all denied with denyClass workspace-write, shell, reserved-tool, subagent, and unknown-tool respectively.
In bypass mode, safe reads are allowed but Bash and explicit hard denies remain denied (bypass stays subject to Chirality hard-deny rules).
createHarnessCanUseTool({sessionId, mode, projectRoot, resolveDescriptor}) returns an async canUseTool(name, input, ctx) SDK callback.
canUseTool hard-denies network-capable Bash commands (e.g. curl) with message 'Network-capable Bash command' and denyClass network-command.
canUseTool hard-denies Bash with dangerouslyDisableSandbox=true (denyClass sandbox-override).
canUseTool hard-denies Bash commands performing parent-directory traversal (denyClass path-traversal).
Each canUseTool decision emits a tool.permission session event recording behavior and safeMetadata; allowed Bash records shellMetadata with effectiveTimeoutMs 120000 (timeoutSource defaulted).
canUseTool hard-denies path-bearing read callbacks outside the active project root (denyClass path-containment) while allowing in-root paths.
tool.permission events capture inputMetadata.inputKeys and pathFields plus descriptorName, adapterToolName, mode, and surface claude-agent-sdk-builtin.
canUseTool hard-denies writes outside the project root (denyClass path-containment).
canUseTool hard-denies writes into the instruction root (denyClass instruction-root).
canUseTool hard-denies writes that resolve through a symbolic link out of the project root (denyClass symlink-write).
sdk-message-mapper module exports createSdkToolEvidenceState and mapSdkMessageToHarness(sessionId, sdkMessage, state?).
mapSdkMessageToHarness maps SDK system/init metadata to a stable 'session:init' UI event and an 'adapter.initialized' HarnessEvent, exposing sdkSessionId and sdkClaudeCodeVersion.
SDK stream_event text deltas map to UI 'chat:delta' events and HarnessEvent types model.delta + message.delta.
An SDK 'result' message maps to UI events chat:complete, session:complete, process:exit and HarnessEvents model.completed + turn.completed.
SDK-only system messages map to provider-neutral HarnessEvents: permission_denied->tool.permission, compact_boundary->context.compacted, mirror_error->runtime.mirror.error.
A permission_denied system message produces tool.permission then tool.failed events with data behavior 'deny', source 'adapter', and the adapter tool name.
An assistant message with text and tool_use maps to chat:delta UI event and HarnessEvents model.delta, message.completed, tool.queued.
tool.queued evidence records source, toolUseId, toolName, descriptorName, and inputMetadata but never the raw tool input.
A queued (priority later, shouldQuery false) user message maps to HarnessEvents message.completed + queue.enqueued.
With evidence state, a Read tool_use result maps to tool.started, tool.completed, message.completed events.
Read tool.completed resultMetadata reports byte length with inlineByteLimit 65536, artifactByteLimit 2097152, overflowPolicy artifact, and rawOutputPersisted false; raw output is not embedded.
Write tool.completed resultMetadata uses inlineByteLimit 16384 and artifactByteLimit 524288 (artifact overflow), without embedding raw output.
Bash tool.completed records shellResultMetadata (stdoutPresent, stderrPresent, byte lengths, interrupted) and inlineByteLimit 16384/artifactByteLimit 2097152, without embedding raw stdout/stderr.
A read tool result with is_error true maps to tool.failed (failureSource tool_use_result) without embedding the raw error content.
An MCP tool result emits only message.completed (skips a duplicate MCP completion event).
SDK tool_progress, hook_started, hook_response, status, and task_started messages map to tool.progress, hook.started, hook.failed, context.compaction.started, and subagent.started respectively.
sdk-options-builder exports buildSdkOptions({session, opts, abortController, systemPrompt}) producing Claude Agent SDK options.
buildSdkOptions defaults settingSources to [] (SDK settings isolation) and exposes only requested read-class tools (e.g. tools and allowedTools = ["Read"]).
Unrequested/denied tools (LS, Bash, Write, Edit, mcp__chirality__status_read) are placed in disallowedTools.
buildSdkOptions sets resume from session.sdkSessionId, model and maxTurns from opts, permissionMode default, and a canUseTool callback function.
In readOnly mode, requested read tools map to allowedTools [Read, Glob, Grep, LS] with all write/shell/network/mcp/agent tools disallowed.
Requesting MCP descriptors (status_read, deps_read) attaches the read-only Chirality MCP server (mcpServers.chirality type 'sdk') and allows those mcp__chirality__ tools.
settingSources allows only 'project' from CHIRALITY_SDK_SETTING_SOURCES, never user or local (mixed sources resolve to []).
Chirality modes map to SDK permissionMode: readOnly->dontAsk, workspaceWrite->acceptEdits, bypass->default unless gated.
bypass mode maps to permissionMode 'bypassPermissions' only when CHIRALITY_ALLOW_SDK_BYPASS=1 gate is set.
Requested Write/Edit/Bash are exposed only in workspaceWrite mode (allowedTools include them, permissionMode acceptEdits); MultiEdit stays disallowed.
In ask mode, write tools yield empty allowed tools and permissionMode default with Write/Edit/Bash disallowed.
The canUseTool callback is backed by Chirality permission decisions: Read allowed; Write denied in ask mode with 'requires application approval'.
In workspaceWrite mode the canUseTool callback allows Write and Bash; in ask mode Bash is denied.
canUseTool denies unknown tools with message "Unknown harness tool '<name>'".
session-events module exports appendHarnessEvent and replayHarnessEvents; event-schema exports createHarnessEvent and HARNESS_EVENT_TYPES.
The session event store root is configured via the CHIRALITY_SESSION_ROOT environment variable.
Canonical HarnessEvent types are provider-neutral and must not contain sdk/claude/anthropic substrings.

HARNESS_EVENT_TYPES includes message.completed, tool.queued/started/progress/completed/failed, hook.started/completed, queue.enqueued, branch.summarized, interruption.requested/completed, context.compaction.started/compacted, and subagent.started/completed.
appendHarnessEvent appends a HarnessEvent as a JSONL record under sessions/<sessionId>/events.jsonl; replayHarnessEvents replays them.
task-scope module exports buildDeliverableCompositeKey, normalizeTaskScopeMode, and sanitizeTaskSelection.
buildDeliverableCompositeKey(pkg, id) builds a "pkg::id" composite deliverable key.
normalizeTaskScopeMode returns 'KNOWLEDGE_TYPES' only when the knowledge-decomposition marker is enabled; otherwise it normalizes to 'DELIVERABLES' (also for unknown modes).
sanitizeTaskSelection clears stale deliverable scopeKeys when scan results no longer include the key.
sanitizeTaskSelection resets a KNOWLEDGE_TYPES selection to DELIVERABLES when the decomposition marker is absent.
sanitizeTaskSelection clears stale knowledge-type targetDeliverableKeys that no longer resolve to a deliverable.
sanitizeTaskSelection preserves valid knowledge-type selections and target keys.
tool-descriptor module exports getCurrentTrancheDisallowedToolNames, getHarnessToolDescriptor, HARNESS_TOOL_REGISTRY_VERSION, listHarnessToolDescriptors, and resolveHarnessToolPool.

listHarnessToolDescriptors returns a fixed-order registry: read_file, find_files, search_files, list_files, status_read, dependency_read, scope_scan, scaffold_preview, write_file, edit_file, multi_edit_file, notebook_edit, shell, web_fetch, web_search, agent.
Read-class descriptors are read_file, find_files, search_files, list_files, status_read, dependency_read, scope_scan, scaffold_preview.
Only read-class descriptors plus write_file, edit_file, and shell are exposed to the model (runtime.exposedToModel=true); all others default to false.
read_file descriptor: permissions [read], pathScope project-root-read, humanGate not required.
write_file descriptor: permissions [workspace-write], pathScope project-root-write, humanGate required.
bash/shell descriptor: permissions [shell, workspace-write, danger], pathScope project-root-write, humanGate required, exposed to model.
resolveHarnessToolPool exposes Write/Edit/Bash only in workspaceWrite mode; in other modes they are disallowed and reported as deniedTools (DENIED_BY_CURRENT_PHASE).
resolveHarnessToolPool resolves read-only Chirality MCP descriptors without opening any write or shell tools.
resolveHarnessToolPool computes disallowedToolNames via getCurrentTrancheDisallowedToolNames(allowed), excluding the allowed set.
resolveHarnessToolPool resolves tool aliases deterministically (e.g. Read/read->read_file) and reports unknown tools as UNKNOWN_TOOL issues including knownTools.
getCurrentTrancheDisallowedToolNames() returns the full tranche disallow list and, given an allowed subset, returns the remaining tools.

TurnEngine is constructed with sessionManager, personaManager, attachmentResolver, agentSdkManager, resolveProviderMode, hasUiApiKey, resolveRuntimeOptions, and evaluateSubagentGovernance dependencies.
TurnEngine builds the system prompt via personaManager.buildSystemPrompt(projectRoot, persona, mode) and resolves attachments before starting the adapter turn.
agentSdkManager.startTurn is invoked with the resolved opts including delegatedSubagents (empty when subagents are disabled).
engine.runTurn runs the full turn lifecycle without HTTP, emitting session:init, chat:complete, session:complete, process:exit and persisting engineSessionId/claudeSessionId/model.
TurnEngine owns same-session turn locking outside the route: a concurrent runTurn rejects with TURN_IN_PROGRESS (status 409); cancel() releases the lock for recovery turns.
For agentSdk provider mode, runTurn rejects unknown tools with INVALID_REQUEST (status 400, 'Unknown harness tool(s): ...') before starting the adapter stream.

deliverable-api module exports WorkspaceApiClientError, canAgentTransitionLifecycle, currentIsoDate, fetchDeliverableDependencies, fetchDeliverableStatus, isExecutionBlockerSubsetRow, nextLifecycleTargets, requiresApprovalShaForTarget, summarizeDependencyRows, and transitionDeliverableStatus.
Dependency register rows use RegisterSchemaVersion v3.1 with fields including DependencyID, DependencyClass, Direction, DependencyType, TargetType, SatisfactionStatus, and Status.
isExecutionBlockerSubsetRow flags active upstream EXECUTION/PREREQUISITE-class pending rows as blockers, excluding ANCHOR class, REQUIREMENT targets, retired rows, and resolved-assumption notes.
summarizeDependencyRows reports totalRows, activeRows, activeUpstreamBlockerCandidates, and bySatisfaction counts.
nextLifecycleTargets returns allowed forward targets per state: OPEN->[INITIALIZED], INITIALIZED->[SEMANTIC_READY, IN_PROGRESS], ISSUED->[].
requiresApprovalShaForTarget returns true for human-gated targets CHECKING and ISSUED (case-insensitive) and false otherwise (including undefined).
canAgentTransitionLifecycle permits only approved agents (e.g. CHANGE, WORKING_ITEMS case-insensitive); DEPENDENCIES and undefined are denied.
fetchDeliverableStatus GETs /api/working-root/deliverable/status with URL-encoded projectRoot and deliverablePath query params and returns the status snapshot.
Workspace API helpers throw a typed WorkspaceApiClientError (name, status, code) for non-2xx responses.
transitionDeliverableStatus POSTs the payload as JSON to /api/working-root/deliverable/status/transition with Content-Type application/json.
fetchDeliverableDependencies loads the dependency register snapshot (rows) from the dependencies route; currentIsoDate(date) returns the YYYY-MM-DD ISO date.
file-tree-refresh module exports createRefreshScheduler, shouldPollWhenHidden, and shouldRefreshForVisibilityState.
createRefreshScheduler({debounceMs, onRefresh, onAfterRefresh}) debounces repeated schedule() calls into a single refresh after debounceMs, then invokes onRefresh and onAfterRefresh once.
scheduler.cancel() cancels pending refresh callbacks so onRefresh is not invoked.
shouldRefreshForVisibilityState treats only 'visible' as a refresh signal (hidden/prerender return false).
shouldPollWhenHidden(hidden) returns false while the window is hidden and true otherwise.
Build/dev Next scripts must set NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 (telemetry disabled in dev:next and build).
The Electron main process must not include autoUpdater, GitHub releases/latest, or api.github.com/repos auto-update checks.
The renderer egress allowlist permits api.anthropic.com, localhost, 127.0.0.1, and [::1], blocking other outbound requests.

The Electron main process enforces a renderer egress allowlist via session.webRequest.onBeforeRequest (RUNTIME_NETWORK_POLICY_ID 'REQ-NET-001') failing closed with NETWORK_POLICY_VIOLATION/INVALID_URL.
Desktop build scripts (desktop:pack, desktop:dist) must force unsigned packaging with CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false.
The macOS build pins a minimum system version major >= 15 and includes an arm64 dmg target.
Packaged build extraResources bundle instruction-root resources: agents (from '../../../agents') and docs (from '../docs').
scripts/verify-instruction-root-integrity.mjs verifies bundled instruction-root files against source hashes.

The instruction-root integrity set is 11 files: AGENTS.md, README.md, PROFESSIONAL_ENGINEERING.md, docs/{WHAT-IS-AN-AGENT,DIRECTIVE,CONTRACT,SPEC,TYPES,PLAN}.md, and agents/{AGENT_WORKING_ITEMS,AGENT_TASK}.md.
The integrity script passes (exit 0, status 'pass') when bundled files match source hashes, writing summary.json with checkedFileCount 11 and empty missing/mismatched/unexpected lists.
The integrity script fails (exit 1, status 'fail') when bundled content diverges, listing the divergent path in mismatchedFiles.
The integrity script supports split source roots (--root-files-root, --agents-root, --docs-root), reporting sourceLayout 'split' and sourceRoot null.
The integrity script auto-detects split source roots from the app-dev frontend workspace cwd (monorepo agents/, projects/chirality-app-dev/docs).
Import statements from next/server and harness http/runtime/types - boilerplate.
POST /api/harness/interrupt reads a JSON body, requires a non-empty sessionId, and calls runtime.turnEngine.interrupt(sessionId), returning {ok:true} (200) or an errorResponse.

POST /api/harness/scaffold reads a JSON body, requires non-empty executionRoot and decompositionPath, calls scaffoldExecutionRoot with optional projectName/coordinationMode, and returns the result (200) or an errorResponse.
